queue.title: Erasure requests
queue.anonymous_by_design: You see a request identifier and its age only. You decide without learning who the person is, and that is deliberate.
queue.lead: Requests under Law N° 058/2021. Declining needs written grounds the citizen is shown. Erasing cannot be undone.

refusal.REFUSED_ACTIVE_APPLICATION: An application is still active. A retention duty applies until it closes.
refusal.REFUSED_ACCEPT_LOCKED: The applicant was accepted by an agency. The record is locked.

decline.title: Decline this erasure request
decline.ground_required: State the legal ground. A refusal without a ground is rejected by the platform and cannot be defended.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your application
withdraw.irreversible: Withdrawing cannot be undone. You may apply again in a future intake.

outcome.NOT_APPLICABLE: This application has reached a final decision and can no longer be withdrawn.

execute.title: Erase this person's data?
execute.body: This runs the gated erasure for the applicant behind this request.

errors.notPending: This request is no longer pending.
errors.generic: The decision could not be recorded. Nothing was changed.
errors.groundsRequired: Written grounds are required to decline.

done.DECLINED: Request declined. The citizen will be shown the grounds.
